name: Central heating boiler
definition: Appliance that heats water for a home's radiators or underfloor heating; heating-only and combi boilers are both included, and a combi boiler pack counts as one product.

name: Furnace
definition: Warm-air heating unit that heats air and sends it through ducts; any fuel.

name: Panel radiator
definition: flat-panel heat emitter, usually fed by hot water.

name: Column radiator
definition: Heater built of upright columns or sections; made in several materials and period styles.

name: Heated towel rail
definition: Heated rail made to warm and dry towels in a bathroom; fed by hot water or electric.

name: Fan heater
definition: Room heater that blows air over a heating element; any fuel.

name: Convector heater
definition: room heater that warms air by natural convection over an element.

name: Oil-filled radiator
definition: portable electric heater with sealed oil-filled fins.

name: Radiant heater
definition: Heater with an exposed bar, quartz or halogen element and a reflector.

name: Infrared panel heater
definition: flat wall- or ceiling-hung panel that heats by infrared radiation; picture-motif prints are variants.

name: Infrared heat lamp
definition: lamp sold as a heater, not a bulb sold as a part.

name: Flued stove
definition: Solid-fuel stove with a firebox vented through a flue.

name: Flueless room heater
definition: Kerosene or gas room heater with no flue.

name: Flued fire
definition: Inset or wall-hung fire vented through a flue; any fuel.

name: Underfloor heating kit
definition: Electric mat or hot-water pipe kit sold to heat a floor.

name: Air-to-water heat pump
definition: Air-to-water heat pump that heats water for radiators or a floor.

name: Ground-source heat pump
definition: Heat pump that draws heat from a loop buried in the ground, whatever it heats.

name: Wall-mounted split air conditioner
definition: Indoor wall unit linked by refrigerant lines to an outdoor unit; many also heat.

name: Floor-standing air conditioner
definition: split air conditioner whose indoor unit stands on the floor as a cabinet.

name: Ceiling cassette air conditioner
definition: split air conditioner whose indoor unit is set into the ceiling.

name: Window air conditioner
definition: single-box unit fitted in a window or wall opening.

name: Portable air conditioner
definition: movable single-box unit venting through a hose.

name: Central air conditioning system
definition: multi-split or ducted plant cooling several rooms, a ducted heat pump included.

name: Desk fan
definition: small fan made to stand on a desk or table.

name: Pedestal fan
definition: fan on a stand or pedestal of adjustable height.

name: Tower fan
definition: tall, narrow fan blowing through a vertical grille.

name: Wall or clip fan
definition: Fan made to mount on a wall or clip to an edge.

name: Handheld fan
definition: Powered hand-held or neck fan; a plain folding hand fan is in Bags & Accessories.

name: Air circulator
definition: fan made to move air round a whole room in a focused stream.

name: Ceiling fan
definition: fan hung from the ceiling, with or without a light.

name: Extractor fan
definition: fan fitted to draw stale air out of a room.

name: Ventilation unit
definition: ventilation unit for a room or home, with or without heat recovery.

name: Air purifier
definition: Appliance that filters particles and pollutants from room air; tower and desktop models, with different filter grades.

name: Humidifier
definition: Appliance that adds moisture to room air; ultrasonic, evaporative and warm-mist types.

name: Portable dehumidifier
definition: movable appliance that draws moisture from room air.

name: Whole-house dehumidifier
definition: dehumidifier installed to treat a whole home, usually ducted.

name: Mini dehumidifier
definition: Small-capacity dehumidifier, often a Peltier-cooled model.

name: Air deodoriser
definition: appliance made to remove odours from room air.

name: Ion generator
definition: appliance that releases ions into room air.

name: Desiccant moisture absorber
definition: Unpowered container of drying crystals that absorbs moisture from a room.

name: Thermostat
definition: Device that switches heating or cooling on and off to hold a set temperature; smart or plain, and smart radiator heads are included.

name: Storage water heater
definition: water heater that heats and holds water in its own tank.

name: Tankless water heater
definition: water heater that heats water on demand as it flows.

name: Heat-pump water heater
definition: Water heater that heats water with a compressor heat pump.

name: Solar water heater
definition: system that heats household water from solar collectors.

name: Solar thermal collector
definition: Flat-plate or evacuated-tube collector sold on its own.

name: Point-of-use water heater
definition: small water heater fitted at one tap or outlet.

name: Hot-water cylinder
definition: Tank heated by a boiler, with no heat source of its own; indirect or buffer cylinders.

name: Water softener
definition: Unit that removes hardness from the home water supply; salt-based or salt-free.

name: Plumbed water filter
definition: Filter plumbed into the supply or fitted to a tap; whole-house, under-sink, shower and tap-mounted types. Jug filters are in Kitchen & Dining.

name: Reverse-osmosis system
definition: unit that purifies water through a reverse-osmosis membrane.

name: UV water treatment system
definition: unit that disinfects water with ultraviolet light.

name: Water distiller
definition: appliance that purifies water by boiling and condensing it.

name: Bathtub
definition: Fixed or freestanding tub for bathing in, in many materials and period styles.

name: Shower
definition: Shower unit or set for washing under running water; electric, mixer and power types.

name: Washbasin
definition: Basin for washing hands and face; some are sold built into their cabinet.

name: Flush toilet
definition: toilet flushed by water from a cistern.

name: Waterless or composting toilet
definition: toilet that uses no flush water, composting or storing the waste.

name: Bidet
definition: separate low basin for washing the lower body.

name: Bidet seat
definition: Powered toilet seat with a warm-water wash.

name: Hard-shell hot tub
definition: Hot tub with a moulded rigid shell and built-in heater and pumps.

name: Inflatable hot tub
definition: Portable hot tub with an inflatable body and a plug-in heater and pump.

name: Wood-fired hot tub
definition: Wooden tub heated by a wood-burning stove.

name: Portable sauna
definition: Sauna that is set up or folded inside a home, not a cabin standing as a building.

name: Solar panel
definition: photovoltaic module that turns sunlight into electricity.

name: Plug-in balcony solar kit
definition: Panel plus micro-inverter sold as one set that plugs into a home socket and feeds the grid, with no storage.

name: Off-grid solar kit
definition: Panels, a charge controller or inverter and usually a battery, sold as one kit to power a place with no grid connection, such as a van, boat or cabin.

name: Small wind turbine
definition: wind turbine sized to generate power for a home or site.

name: Inverter
definition: device that converts DC from panels or batteries to household AC.

name: Charge controller
definition: device that regulates charging of a battery from solar panels.

name: Home battery
definition: Rechargeable battery that stores electricity for a home; a portable power station is the carried version.

name: Energy monitor
definition: device that measures and shows a home's electricity use or generation.

name: Replacement air filter
definition: Filter made to fit an air purifier, humidifier or dehumidifier.

name: Softener salt
definition: Salt used up in a water softener; dishwasher salt is in Cleaning & Laundry.

name: Water filter cartridge
definition: Cartridge made to fit a water filter or treatment unit.

name: Solar panel mount
definition: Mounting frame or bracket made for solar panels.

name: Window fan
definition: fan made to fit in a window opening to draw air in or blow it out, single or twin, often reversible.

name: Box fan
definition: portable fan with its blade set in a square box frame, standing on the floor or in a window.

name: Rapid shutdown device
definition: module-level switch that cuts a solar array's DC voltage on command or loss of grid, made for PV panels.

name: Power optimizer
definition: module-level DC-DC converter fitted to each solar panel to maximise its output before the inverter.

name: PV combiner box
definition: enclosure that joins several solar panel strings into one output, with fuses or breakers, made for a PV array.

name: Battery-bank charger
definition: mains- or generator-fed charger made to charge a home or off-grid battery bank.

name: Battery enclosure
definition: box or cabinet made to house the cells or modules of a home or off-grid battery bank.

name: Swim spa
definition: long hard-shell spa with a swim current, heated and filtered like a hot tub, for swimming in place.
